verdict.rationale: Databricks documents an ingestion hub for choosing 'a standard connector by data source' (docs-20), Auto Loader/Lakeflow pipelines for cloud storage ingestion (docs-1, docs-13), and dedicated partner docs for dbt setup (docs-10, docs-14, docs-35), plus a Lakeflow Connect skill surfaced via the CLI (probe-rt-2). However the pack lacks a concrete, itemized list of first-party/partner connectors for specific SaaS apps and databases with individual setup guides beyond dbt — missing for 10: enumerated SaaS/database connector catalog (e.g., Salesforce, Workday, Postgres, SQL Server) with per-connector setup docs, and independent evidence validating ease of setup.
